name: Trilinear B-spline Wavelet Encoding
aliases: Trilinear B-spline Wavelet Encoding for 3D Multiresolution
definition: A multiresolution data representation technique for n-dimensional data (specifically n=3) that combines d/z subdivision with trilinear B-spline wavelets to improve approximation quality on coarser levels of detail compared to standard subdivision without wavelets.
summary: Trilinear B-spline Wavelet Encoding is a multiresolution technique that improves 3D volume approximation quality and ensures topological accuracy by reorganizing data into wavelet coefficients using narrow lifting masks.
